title: Opinion 22-03 (Department of Health, Construction Review Services): AHJ use of IBC/IFC Section 104 to evaluate alternative methods for small Group I facilities treated as R-4
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by Department of Health, Construction Review Services (comparative test only; not Alberta)
code_edition: 2018 International Building Code and 2018 International Fire Code, Section 104, as cited

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council opinion no. 22-03, one page; requester Department of Health, Construction Review Services.
Occupancies in question: Institutional Group I with more than five and not more than 16 persons, excluding staff.
Proposed treatment: those occupancies to be constructed as Residential Group R-4 under 2018 IBC Section 310.5.
Background states that Washington struck the R-4 designation while the ICC model has since added a building-science R-4 model with active and passive fire and life-safety mitigations.

limitations: The PDF contains the Council answer on the same page; do not present it as applicant-side input without flagging leakage.
